Night Cream with Vitamin C: Benefits and How to Use It

By Mohammed Nihal, founderPublished 16 October 2026Updated 16 October 20265 min read
Quick answer

A night cream with vitamin C can help dull, tired-looking skin look brighter and more even over time while keeping it moisturised overnight. It is usually gentler than a strong serum. Use it on clean skin at night and wear sunscreen every morning.

  • Vitamin C is an antioxidant known for a brighter, more even look.
  • Pure vitamin C breaks down with air, light and heat.
  • A more even look usually takes 8–12 weeks.
  • Mirc Glow Glutathione Cream contains vitamin C.

A night cream with vitamin C can help dull, tired-looking skin look brighter and more even over time, while the cream itself keeps skin moisturised overnight. Vitamin C is usually gentler in a cream than in a strong serum, which makes it an easy way to try this ingredient.

Here is what vitamin C does, how to use it at night, how it fits with other ingredients, and what to compare when you look at vitamin C face cream prices in India.

What vitamin C does in skincare

Vitamin C is an antioxidant. In skincare it is known for helping skin look brighter and more even, and for supporting skin against everyday stress from sun and pollution. It is one of the most popular ingredients for dull skin.

Pure vitamin C (ascorbic acid) is unstable and breaks down with air, light and heat. That is why many creams use gentler, more stable forms of vitamin C, and why packaging and storage matter.

Vitamin C face cream benefits

  • Brighter-looking skin. Regular use can make a tired complexion look fresher.
  • A more even-looking tone. It can help reduce the look of dark spots and patchiness over time.
  • Antioxidant support. Useful for city skin exposed to sun and pollution.
  • Easy to use. In a cream, it comes with moisture built in, so there is one less step.

Be patient. Skin renews roughly every 4–6 weeks, so most people need 8–12 weeks of regular use to see a more even look.

Night cream with vitamin C vs a morning serum

You will often read that vitamin C belongs in the morning, under sunscreen. That works well for serums. But a night cream with vitamin C has its own advantages:

Vitamin C serum (morning)Vitamin C night cream
TextureLight, wateryCreamy, moisturising
StrengthOften higherUsually gentler
StepsNeeds a moisturiser tooOne step at night
Best forExperienced users, oily skinBeginners, dry or normal skin

Whichever you choose, wear sunscreen every morning. Without it, any brightening-focused routine works against itself.

Vitamin C cream for dull skin

Dull skin usually comes from a mix of dryness, dead skin build-up, late nights and sun. A vitamin C cream for dull skin helps most when the basics are in place:

  1. Cleanse properly at night to clear sunscreen, sweat and pollution.
  2. Exfoliate gently once a week at most, on a different night from your actives.
  3. Apply your vitamin C night cream to clean, dry skin.
  4. Drink water and sleep well. These show on the face.
  5. Use sunscreen every morning.

Our glass skin routine for Indian skin shows how to put these steps together for a smooth, glowing look.

Vitamin C for uneven skin tone

Vitamin C works well alongside other brightening-focused ingredients. Common partners are niacinamide (vitamin B3), kojic acid and glutathione. Used together in one well-made cream, they can support a more even-looking tone without you having to layer several products.

For stubborn patches, keep expectations realistic. If you have melasma, or patches that keep spreading, see a dermatologist rather than adding more products. Our guide to kojic acid cream for dark spots explains how to set goals for the look of spots.

Vitamin C face cream price in India: what to compare

Prices vary widely, so compare more than the number on the jar:

  • Price per gram. Divide the price by the weight. Our Glutathione Cream works out to about ₹50 per gram.
  • Full ingredient list. Check where vitamin C appears and what it is combined with.
  • Packaging. Opaque, airtight jars or tubes help protect vitamin C.
  • Honest wording. Be wary of "instant" or overnight promises. Good brands talk about a brighter, more even look.
  • Delivery and returns. We ship free across India, usually in 3–7 days, with Cash on Delivery available.

Using vitamin C safely

  • Patch test on a small area for a day or two.
  • Mild tingling can happen at first; burning, a rash or swelling means stop.
  • Do not use it on the same night as strong exfoliating acids when you are starting out.
  • Store the cream closed, away from sunlight and heat.
  • If you are pregnant or have a skin condition, ask your doctor first.

Short answers

Can I use vitamin C cream at night? Yes. A vitamin C night cream is a gentle way to use it, as long as you wear sunscreen in the morning.

Does Mirc Glow have a cream with vitamin C? Yes, our Glutathione Cream contains vitamin C along with glutathione, kojic acid, aloe vera and niacinamide.

Can vitamin C and niacinamide be used together? Yes, for most people they work well together in one routine.

How long does vitamin C cream take to show a change? Usually around 8–12 weeks of regular use for a more even look.

Is vitamin C cream good for oily skin? It can be. Use a thin layer and choose a lighter texture in summer.

This is general skincare information, not medical advice. Patch test any new product, and see a dermatologist if you have a skin condition.
